cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've kept twelve tickets from our trips. Submit your total before you claim you care as much as I do.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I kept mine in the album I made for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The album is under my protection. I award myself the extra care required to preserve your gift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Open it. I reinforced every page so your tickets could go in with mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Reinforcement approved. Put my tickets in too; I'll get a waterproof cover. You're providing memories, but I'm protecting both our collections.

reason: Rereading found A claimed both collections already under protection before A tickets were placed in the album. Make insertion a directed next step before claiming shared preservation.
